workoutPlans.originalPlan:
Day 1: Upper Body Power (Chest & Back)
Warm-up: 8 mins dynamic arm circles, band pull-aparts, thoracic mobility
Main Workout:
- Barbell Bench Press: 4 sets x 6 reps (Heavy)
- Weighted Pull-Ups / Lat Pulldowns: 4 sets x 8 reps
- Incline Dumbbell Press: 3 sets x 10 reps
- Bent-Over Barbell Rows: 4 sets x 8 reps
- Cable Face Pulls: 3 sets x 15 reps
Cooldown: 7 mins chest doorway stretch, lat hang, deep breathing

Day 2: Lower Body Strength (Quads & Hamstrings)
Warm-up: 10 mins bodyweight squats, hip 90/90 openers, leg swings
Main Workout:
- Barbell Back Squat: 4 sets x 6 reps
- Romanian Deadlifts (RDL): 3 sets x 8 reps
- Bulgarian Split Squats: 3 sets x 10 reps per leg
- Standing Calf Raises: 4 sets x 12 reps
- Hanging Leg Raises: 3 sets x 12 reps
Cooldown: 6 mins seated forward fold, couch stretch for hip flexors

Day 3: Active Recovery & Core
Warm-up: 5 mins gentle flow
Main Workout:
- 30 mins brisk incline outdoor walk or stationary cycle
- Bird-Dogs: 3 sets x 10 reps per side
- Plank Variations: 3 sets x 45 secs
- Deadbugs: 3 sets x 12 reps
Cooldown: 8 mins full body foam rolling & hydration

Day 4: Shoulders & Arms Hypertrophy
Warm-up: 6 mins light dumbbell halo & rotator cuff warm-up
Main Workout:
- Overhead Barbell Military Press: 4 sets x 8 reps
- Dumbbell Lateral Raises: 4 sets x 12-15 reps (controlled tempo)
- Incline Dumbbell Bicep Curls: 3 sets x 10 reps
- Tricep Rope Cable Pushdowns: 3 sets x 12 reps
- Reverse Pec Deck Flyes: 3 sets x 15 reps
Cooldown: 6 mins overhead tricep stretch, cross-body shoulder stretch

Day 5: Posterior Chain & Heavy Pull
Warm-up: 8 mins glute bridges, cat-cow mobility, world's greatest stretch
Main Workout:
- Conventional Deadlift: 4 sets x 5 reps
- Dumbbell Single-Arm Rows: 3 sets x 10 reps per arm
- Hamstring Leg Curls: 3 sets x 12 reps
- Hammer Curls: 3 sets x 10 reps
Cooldown: 7 mins pigeon pose stretch, lower back gentle decompression

Day 6: Functional Full Body & Conditioning
Warm-up: 7 mins jumping jacks, inchworms, high knees
Main Workout:
- Kettlebell Swings: 4 sets x 15 reps
- Dumbbell Push Press: 3 sets x 8 reps
- Goblet Squats: 3 sets x 12 reps
- Dips (Chest/Tricep): 3 sets x 10-12 reps
- Ab Wheel Rollouts: 3 sets x 10 reps
Cooldown: 6 mins child's pose, butterfly groin stretch

Day 7: Full Rest & Regeneration
Warm-up: None (Rest day)
Main Workout:
- Complete nervous system recovery
- 20 mins casual walk in nature or light mobility
Cooldown: 10 mins contrast shower or sauna relaxation

workoutPlans.nutritionTip: Aim for 1.8 to 2.2 grams of protein per kilogram of bodyweight, distributed across 4 balanced meals. Pair your post-workout protein with fast-digesting carbohydrates (like a banana, rice cakes, or honey) to replenish muscle glycogen and maximize muscle protein synthesis.

chatHistory.content: What can I do instead of squats?

Here's my coaching recommendation for "What can I do instead of squats?":

When optimizing your training for muscle gain, consistency and movement quality take top priority. If you need exercise substitutions, focus on preserving the fundamental movement pattern (push, pull, hinge, squat, or carry) with whatever equipment you have available.

Make sure you are drinking enough water (2.9L/day) and taking 60-90 seconds of rest between working sets for recovery.

*Note: Always listen to your body; if you feel sharp joint pain rather than muscular fatigue, rest and consult a healthcare professional.*
